text: At noon the study group meets by the garden. The group tests a model carrier and records the results. Later the group compares the original message with the decoded text.
ВСТРЕЧА УЧЕБНОЙ ГРУППЫ В ДЕСЯТЬ ЧАСОВ

At noon the study group records its observations in a shared notebook. The class changes the arrangement of letters and checks whether the original text can be recovered. Each small experiment provides evidence about a property of the model. The results from the previous exercise are compared with the output of the new exercise. The fictional team observes which letters occur most often in a long passage. The instructor then asks the teams to compare the decoded notes with the originals.
